card.name: Punctuation before biologic drug names
card.fires_on: Commas, colons, spaces and small linking words that sit right before a specific drug name, mostly in lists of drugs or switching instructions for complement inhibitors and FcRn inhibitors. Also fires on section-number digits in parentheses.

modes.label: Lists of drug examples
modes.description: A comma, colon or the word example just before the next named drug in an interaction list.

modes.label: Switching or administration wording
modes.description: A small word such as of or from just before a brand or drug name in switching and administration headings.
modes.example: For patients switching<< from>> ravulizumab, initiate EMP

modes.label: Numbers and cross-references
modes.description: A space or digit before a dose figure or a section reference in parentheses.

card.plain: It marks the spot just before a drug name is about to appear in a list or a switching instruction.
